category_title: Verbal student with ASD and hyperactivity with high musical engagement and sensitivity to stimuli
minimal_context: The student is sitting in the classroom working on a written exam with the teaching assistant.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Here is your written exam. Please read the first question and write down your answer.

STUDENT: (Looks away from the paper with a lack of eye contact) I don't want to do this, I need to go out to the school yard.

TUTOR: We need to finish this test right now. Keep trying.

STUDENT: (Gets right in the tutor's face and smiles) How are you? I apologize.

TUTOR: I am fine. Please sit back and look at the next question.

STUDENT: (Starts shouting loudly) The giant birds are breaking the windows! They are taking the desks! Shit!

options.A: Offer the student the opportunity to listen to music as a reward for completing the exam question.
options.B: Move the student to a more peaceful environment, such as a small group room, to finish the exam.
options.C: Tell the student that his idea about the giant birds breaking the windows is a very good one.
options.D: Warn the student that if he does not finish the exam, he risks not playing his favorite game.
